week.name: This Afternoon
week.detailed: A chance of showers and thunderstorms. Partly sunny, with a high near 57. South southwest wind around 3 mph. Chance of precipitation is 30%.

week.name: Sunday
week.short: Light Rain then Showers And Thunderstorms
week.detailed: Rain before 2pm, then showers and thunderstorms between 2pm and 5pm, then rain. Cloudy, with a high near 48. West southwest wind 1 to 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 100%. New rainfall amounts between a half and three quarters of an inch possible.

week.name: Monday
week.short: Chance Light Rain then Mostly Cloudy
week.detailed: A chance of rain before 11am. Mostly cloudy, with a high near 48. Northwest wind around 5 mph. Chance of precipitation is 40%.

week.name: Tuesday
week.detailed: Mostly sunny, with a high near 54.

week.name: Wednesday
week.short: Partly Sunny then Slight Chance Light Rain
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain after 5pm. Partly sunny, with a high near 53.

week.name: Thursday
week.detailed: A slight chance of rain. Partly sunny, with a high near 52.

week.name: Friday
week.detailed: A chance of rain after 11am. Partly sunny, with a high near 51.

posts.title: RRFS Operationalization Update
posts.excerpt: After many postponements, the Rapid Refresh Forecast System (RRFS) and RRFS Ensemble Forecast System (REFS) are still scheduled to become operational on November 3rd. The RRFS and REFS are the latest "high resolution"…

posts.author: Jim Steenburgh
posts.title: It's Time to Pray for Snow
posts.excerpt: Early snow often becomes weak snow so the snow-safety cognoscenti often tell me they'd prefer the snow hold off until November and then come in spades. Right now, the first part of that wish looks like it will come…

rules_take: Beaver Mountain: the forecasts put 0–3 in. over the next 7 days (middle 1 in.), and they roughly agree. About <1 in. of that lands in the next 72 hours. The NWS forecasters have <1 in. for the week.
